label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.44 a.1…: A being that has ESSE_BY_PARTICIPATION_1 is caused…
interpretation: The corpus argues from participated being to the first being whose esse belongs essentially; reply 1 says that being by participation entails being caused by another, while being caused is not part of being simply. This is a one-way source reading, not the converse that essence–esse identity alone implies uncausedness, nor an identification of participated esse with Platonic participation.
